required_fixes: Rebuild the roof silhouette as the documented mansard/slate roof with correctly proportioned dormers, cornice/eaves, and the prominent central tower/steeple and cupola. Current saved views show a large flat roof slab and a small open, square cupola-like frame.

Replace the uniform box massing with the historic building's differentiated front/rear elevations, setbacks and recognizable Victorian proportions. Confirm building orientation and roof plan against current orthophotos and the official GIS polygon.

Rework the facade with correct brick/stone composition, cream/white window surrounds, lintels, sills, brackets, cornices and entrance details. Current windows are repetitive dark rectangles and the elevations lack the source building's defining ornament.

Model the renovated interior sufficiently to match Purdue's two-story central gallery/atrium, stairs, circulation, floors, columns and representative student/common spaces. The cutaway currently exposes broad blank slabs and very sparse furnishings rather than recognizable rooms and circulation.

Improve material realism and control: the asset has 18 assigned node materials and procedural brick nodes, but no image textures; render results remain flat, with a featureless roof and weak facade variation. Add appropriate brick, stone and slate surface relief/color variation and inspect them under neutral daylight.
limitations: AABB GIS screening is not a surveyed footprint fit or a wall-perimeter comparison.
The official renovation plans are proposed design drawings from 2022; current Purdue 2025 pages were used for the renovated program and architectural/photo reference.
The grading render setup adds temporary cameras, lights and ground and does not save them into the building library.
